Find starting values for predicted values plots from the data in the model frame, if not supplied

Source: R/tseffects.R
get.value.Rd

Find starting values for predicted values plots from the data in the model frame, if not supplied

Usage

get.value(var, prediction.values, model)

Arguments

var

the variable to establish a prediction value for

prediction.values

(possible) user-supplied list of values for variables

model

the model containing the dataframe for mean estimation if values are not user-supplied (and warn the user if we're taking the mean)

Author

Soren Jordan, Garrett N. Vande Kamp, and Reshi Rajan
